target.title: Preserve settings window position
target.body:
Fixes #17
## Summary

Preserve the Settings window position across app launches.

The Settings window is created manually with AppKit and was previously centered every time it was recreated. That meant users lost their preferred Settings window placement after quitting and relaunching Nameplate.

This change gives the Settings window a stable AppKit frame autosave name and restores any saved frame before falling back to centering. The window is only centered when no saved frame exists, so a restored frame is not overwritten.

## Validation

- `git diff --check`
- `swift build`

Source proof:

```text
PROOF autosave-name-defined=true
PROOF restore-before-autosave=true
PROOF center-guarded-after-restore=true
```
